reviews.text: Very thankful for Comfort King's! Our furnace was out on a very cold day, and they came quickly and fixed it. They are a company that gives back to their community, and helps out our ministry with any of our heating and cooling needs!
I highly recommend Comfort Kings! My experience has been done proficient and in a timely manner, with consistent follow ups showing genuine concern for my service being done correctly!!

Man where can I start, it was a very hot and I mean hot!!!! June night and my a/c decided to clock itself out. I called everyone and every a/c company around and they were charging ridiculously more and at a way longer wait time... had it all fixed up in under 30 minutes a complete professional at his job.

eyebrow: Mitsubishi Diamond Elite Contractor · Veteran-owned — Shawnee & Overland Park
lede: A local, veteran-owned HVAC company founded in 2019. Free estimates on new equipment, up-front pricing on every repair, and labor warranties that match the manufacturer's parts warranty on new installs.

card4.title: Mitsubishi ductless mini-splits
card4.body: Diamond Elite contractor for Mitsubishi Electric ductless systems, for homes and commercial spaces.

reviews.text: I have never been more impressed with a service company! Our AC went out and I called Cool Heat KC on Sunday of Labor Day Weekend as they came highly recommended to us. I was expecting to get an answering machine, but Rick picked up right away and came over immediately.
Cool Heat KC came out on an emergency call when temps were high. He stayed late and evaluated the entire system to ensure the repairs made were all that was needed for our older system.

Even when the temps are in the 90's and you 'hear a weird noise' coming from the air conditioner, Rick and his team are 'on it' to resolve and repair the issue!!! Super Fast … Super Friendly … Super Efficient!!!

areaLede: Serving Shawnee, Overland Park and the surrounding Kansas City area, for homes and businesses.

reviews.text: The technician got here within an hour of calling. He was very nice and replaced the capacitor within and hour. It was a great experience and I will definitely use them again!!!

This was a general service call. My HVAC stopped cooling and the condenser and evaporator coils froze. The technician showed up 15 minutes early and solved the issue within 2-3 minutes. Excellent mannerisms for customer service.
Fast, effective, very polite. Worth every penny.

eyebrow: Heating · Cooling — locally owned, serving the Kansas City metro
lede: A locally owned, family-operated heating and cooling company with a perfect 5-star Google rating. Honest diagnoses, fair prices and no pressure to buy extras.

card4.title: Clean, courteous installs
card4.body: New furnaces and air conditioners installed with care, and the job site left clean.

reviews.text: Very professional. I called them up for my AC not running, they came out the very next morning. Found what was wrong with it in a timely manner, had it all fixed and ready to go within an hour. No up charges, no pressure to buy additional things, just a fixed AC and ready to go with a great price! 100% recommend them to anyone!

Honest, reliable & consistent, quality work! Tyler is always so friendly & patient with all my questions and I can always count on Jeremy to be responsive & happy to get the job done! Can’t beat Gunn Heating & Cooling!

Gunn installed the whole kit and caboodle! A new heater, air conditioner and hot water tank. The staff could not be any better. When I asked how much a new thermostat would cost they came back the next day and installed one for free!!!!
